2.name: Sharptalon's Claw
text: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

8.name: A Rogue's Deal
text: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to Innkeeper Renee in Tirisfal Glades.

23.name: Ursangous's Paw
text: Bring Ursangous's Paw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

24.name: Shadumbra's Head
text: Bring Shadumbra's Head to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

27.name: A Lesson to Learn
text: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

28.name: Trial of the Lake

objectives.text: Complete the Trial of the Lake

text: Find a Shrine Bauble in Lake Elune'ara, and take it to the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern Moonglade. Once there, use the Shrine Bauble.
You must speak with Tajarri at the shrine afterwards in order to complete the trial.

30.name: Trial of the Sea Lion
text: Find the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance. Speak with the residents of Moonglade to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
Form the Pendant of the Sea Lion from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.
Bring the joined pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

31.name: Aquatic Form
text: Return to Thunder Bluff and show Turak Runetotem the Pendant of the Sea Lion.

63.name: Call of Water
text: Defeat the Corrupt Manifestation of Water and place the Corrupted Manifestation's Bracers along with the Remaining Drops of Purest Water on the Brazier of Everfount in Silverpine Forest.

96.name: Call of Water
text: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

99.name: Arugal's Folly
text: Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

100.name: Call of Water
text: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Silverpine Forest.

216.name: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur
text: Take down 8 Thistlefur Avengers and 8 Thistlefur Shaman; most are located east of Zoram Strand in Thistlefur Village. Once completed, return to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

220.name: Call of Water
text: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

235.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
text: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

264.name: Until Death Do Us Part
text: Place Clarice's Pendant on Yuriv's Tomb in Silverpine.
notes: The Pools of Vision is the cave under the Spirit Rise; enter at 29.84, 29.88. Clarice Foster walks around inside.

354.name: Deaths in the Family
text: Bring Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains and Thurman's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.

355.name: Speak with Sevren
text: Speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

356.name: Rear Guard Patrol
text: Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.

357.name: The Lich's Identity
text: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

358.name: Graverobbers
text: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.
Bring 8 Embalming Ichors to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

359.name: Forsaken Duties
text: Speak with Deathguard Linnea.

360.name: Return to the Magistrate
text: Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

361.name: A Letter Undelivered
text: Find Yvette Farthing, and deliver to her the letter from Thurman Agamand.

362.name: The Haunted Mills
text: Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring Devlin's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.

363.name: Rude Awakening
text: Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis.

364.name: The Mindless Ones
text: Shadow Priest Sarvis wants you to kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies.

365.name: Fields of Grief
text: Steal 10 pumpkins from the farm to the west, just north of Deathknell and take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.

366.name: Return the Book
text: Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.

367.name: A New Plague
text: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.

368.name: A New Plague
text: Apothecary Johaan of the town of Brill needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in Tirisfal Glades.

369.name: A New Plague
text: Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider.

370.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
text: Executor Zygand in Brill wants you to kill Captain Perrine, 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries.

371.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
text: Executor Zygand in Brill has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars.

372.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
text: Executor Zygand in the town of Brill wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.

374.name: Proof of Demise
text: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.

375.name: The Chill of Death
text: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.

376.name: The Damned
text: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.

380.name: Night Web's Hollow
text: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.

381.name: The Scarlet Crusade
text: Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.

382.name: The Red Messenger
text: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.

383.name: Vital Intelligence
text: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.

398.name: Wanted: Maggot Eye
text: Kill Maggot Eye and return to Executor Zygand in Brill with his paw for a reward.

404.name: A Putrid Task
text: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

405.name: The Prodigal Lich
text: Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

407.name: Fields of Grief
text: Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured Scarlet Zealot who is being held in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.

408.name: The Family Crypt
text: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.
Kill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

409.name: Proving Allegiance
text: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning.
Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her.
Return to Gunther on his island.

411.name: The Prodigal Lich Returns
text: Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

421.name: Prove Your Worth
text: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.

422.name: Arugal's Folly
text: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

423.name: Arugal's Folly
text: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

424.name: Arugal's Folly
text: Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

425.name: Ivar the Foul
text: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.

426.name: The Mills Overrun
text: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

427.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
text: Executor Zygand of Brill wants you to kill 10 Scarlet Warriors.

428.name: Lost Deathstalkers
text: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.

429.name: Wild Hearts
text: Gather 6 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

430.name: Return to Quinn
text: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

435.name: Escorting Erland
text: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.

437.name: The Dead Fields
text: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.
When Nightlash appears, kill her.
Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

438.name: The Decrepit Ferry
text: Go to the Decrepit Ferry.
Search for the reason the Scourge are there.

439.name: Rot Hide Clues
text: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

440.name: The Engraved Ring
text: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

441.name: Raleigh and the Undercity
text: Bring Deliah's Ring to Raleigh.

442.name: Assault on Fenris Isle
text: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

443.name: Rot Hide Ichor
text: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

444.name: Rot Hide Origins
text: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

445.name: Delivery to Silverpine Forest
text: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.

446.name: Thule Ravenclaw
text: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.

447.name: A Recipe For Death
text: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

448.name: Report to Hadrec
text: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

449.name: The Deathstalkers' Report
text: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

450.name: A Recipe For Death
text: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

451.name: A Recipe For Death
text: Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

452.name: Pyrewood Ambush
text: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.

460.name: Resting in Pieces
text: Bring Alaric's Head to his grave.

461.name: The Hidden Niche
text: Take Alaric to the hidden alcove.

477.name: Border Crossings
text: Retrieve the contents of one of the Dalaran wizards' crates. You will find Pyrewood Village to the south.

478.name: Maps and Runes
text: Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

479.name: Ambermill Investigations
text: Obtain 8 Dalaran Pendants for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

480.name: The Weaver
text: Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

481.name: Dalar's Analysis
text: Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

482.name: Dalaran's Intentions
text: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

491.name: Wand to Bethor
text: Take the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

492.name: A New Plague
text: Bring Johaan's Special Drink to the Captured Mountaineer.

493.name: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills
text: Deliver Apothecary Renferrel's findings to Apothecary Lydon in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

494.name: Time To Strike
text: Travel to Tarren Mill to deliver Deathstalker Lesh's message to High Executor Darthalia.

496.name: Elixir of Suffering
text: Apothecary Lydon of Tarren Mill wants 10 Gray Bear Tongues and some Creeper Ichor.

498.name: The Rescue
text: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.

499.name: Elixir of Suffering
text: Give Umpi the Elixir of Suffering.

516.name: Beren's Peril
text: Locate Beren's Peril, then kill 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, then return to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

527.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
text: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

528.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
text: Kill 15 Hillsbrad Peasants and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

529.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
text: Kill Blacksmith Verringtan and 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmiths.
Retrieve a shipment of iron and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

530.name: A Husband's Revenge
text: Kill Valdred Moray.
Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.

532.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
text: Kill Magistrate Burnside and 5 Hillsbrad Councilmen. Destroy the Hillsbrad Proclamation. Steal the Hillsbrad Town Registry. Report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill afterwards.

539.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
text: Kill Foreman Bonds and 10 Hillsbrad Miners and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

541.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
text: Travel to Dun Garok and kill 8 Mountaineers, 4 Riflemen, 2 Priests and Captain Ironhill and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

546.name: Souvenirs of Death
text: Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad Human Skulls.

549.name: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel
text: Kill 10 Syndicate Rogues and 10 Syndicate Watchmen. Return to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill for your reward.

567.name: Dangerous!
text: High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.

590.name: A Rogue's Deal
text: Defeat Calvin Montague in Deathknell.

742.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
text: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

743.name: Dangers of the Windfury
text: Bring 8 Windfury Talons to Ruul Eagletalon in Bloodhoof Village.

744.name: Preparation for Ceremony
text: Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in Thunder Bluff.

745.name: Sharing the Land
text: Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Two camps. Clear one, walk to the other, and by the time you are back the first has respawned.

746.name: Dwarven Digging
text: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.
At a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.
Bring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Smash the picks at the forge in the middle of the dig.

747.name: The Hunt Begins
text: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.
notes: Circle the camp on the marked points. Meat and feathers drop from the same birds.

748.name: Poison Water
text: Bring 6 Prairie Wolf Paws and 4 Plainstrider Talons to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof.
notes: Mull plays out a short scene before he offers the next quest.

749.name: The Ravaged Caravan
text: Morin Cloudstalker wants you to examine the contents of a supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan.
notes: Morin Cloudstalker walks the road between the village and the eastern hills. Follow the road until you meet him.
The crate is what is left of the caravan.

750.name: The Hunt Continues
text: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.

751.name: The Ravaged Caravan
text: Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
notes: The crate is what is left of the caravan.
Morin is walking the eastern road again.

752.name: A Humble Task
text: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.
notes: Greatmother Hawkwind is at the south end of the camp.

753.name: A Humble Task
text: Take a Water Pitcher from the water well.
Return the pitcher to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache which is northwest from the water well.
notes: Greatmother Hawkwind is at the south end of the camp.
The pitcher sits on the well right behind her.

754.name: Winterhoof Cleansing
text: Use the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem at the Winterhoof Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
notes: Mull plays out a short scene before he offers the next quest.
Use the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem at the well.

755.name: Rites of the Earthmother
text: Travel to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.
notes: Seer Graytongue stands south of the camp. Kill cougars on the way down.

756.name: Thunderhorn Totem
text: Bring 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws to Mull Thunderhorn.

757.name: Rite of Strength
text: Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
notes: Seer Graytongue stands south of the camp. Kill cougars on the way down.

758.name: Thunderhorn Cleansing
text: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
notes: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the well. The well is on the way west out of the village.

759.name: Wildmane Totem
text: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Hunters: an alpha is worth taming here for the second rank of Bite.

760.name: Wildmane Cleansing
text: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
notes: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the last well.

761.name: Swoop Hunting
text: Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Skip this if you are still short of quills.

763.name: Rites of the Earthmother
text: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.

764.name: The Venture Co
text: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Morin is walking the eastern road again.
Morin is on the eastern road.

765.name: Supervisor Fizsprocket
text: Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Morin is walking the eastern road again.
Run in and hug the eastern wall. Fizsprocket is at the back.
Morin is on the eastern road.

766.name: Mazzranache
text: Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, Flatland Cougar Femur, Plainstrider Scale and Swoop Gizzard to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Whatever Mazzranache is still missing is on this sweep south: wolves and stalkers, cougars, plainstriders and swoops.

767.name: Rite of Vision
text: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.

768.name: Gathering Leather
text: Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
notes: Skip this and the two steps after it if you did not train Skinning.

769.name: Kodo Hide Bag
text: Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.

770.name: The Demon Scarred Cloak
text: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.

771.name: Rite of Vision
text: Collect 2 Well Stones and 2 Ambercorn and bring them back to Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Ambercorns lie on the ground under the trees.
Well Stones lie around the Winterhoof well.
A wolf spirit appears when you take the quest. Do not follow it; you are going to the cave yourself.

772.name: Rite of Vision
text: Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.
notes: A wolf spirit appears when you take the quest. Do not follow it; you are going to the cave yourself.

773.name: Rite of Wisdom
text: Travel to Red Rocks east of Thunder Bluff and speak with the Ancestral Spirit.
notes: The Ancestral Spirit waits at the top of the rise.

775.name: Journey into Thunder Bluff
text: Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
notes: The Ancestral Spirit waits at the top of the rise.

776.name: Rites of the Earthmother
text: Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
notes: Arra'chea is the big black kodo. He walks a slow clockwise circuit of northern Mulgore, so pick him up wherever the loop meets him.

780.name: The Battleboars
text: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to kill Battleboars and bring back 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks.

781.name: Attack on Camp Narache
text: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
notes: The map lies on the ground in the small cave at the south edge of the camp.
Use the map to start its quest.

784.name: Vanquish the Betrayers
text: Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.

786.name: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

objectives.text: Attack Plan: Valley of Trials destroyed

text: Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.

788.name: Cutting Teeth
text: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

789.name: Sting of the Scorpid
text: Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.

790.name: Sarkoth
text: Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.

791.name: Carry Your Weight
text: Furl Scornbrow in the Razor Hill watchtower wants 8 Canvas Scraps.

792.name: Vile Familiars
text: Kill 12 Vile Familiars.
Return to Zureetha Fargaze outside the Den.

794.name: Burning Blade Medallion
text: Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.

804.name: Sarkoth
text: Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek at the Den.

805.name: Report to Sen'jin Village
text: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

806.name: Dark Storms
text: Bring Fizzle's Claw to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

808.name: Minshina's Skull
text: Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles.
Bring it to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

809.name: Ak'Zeloth
text: Speak with Ak'Zeloth in the Barrens.
notes: Ak'Zeloth is on the road from Durotar.

812.name: Need for a Cure
text: Find Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar and get the Venomtail Antidote. Then bring the antidote to Rhinag near the northwestern border of Durotar.

813.name: Finding the Antidote
text: Bring 4 Venomtail Poison Sacs to Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar.

815.name: Break a Few Eggs
text: Bring 3 Taillasher Eggs to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.

816.name: Lost But Not Forgotten
text: Bring a sign of Kron's fate to Misha Tor'kren at the farmstead northwest of Razor Hill.

817.name: Practical Prey
text: Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.

818.name: A Solvent Spirit
text: Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.

819.name: Chen's Empty Keg
text: Find someone who knows about Chen's Empty Keg.
notes: Chen's Empty Keg spawns on the ground here. Skip if it is not there; you pass by again later.
Use the keg to start its quest.
The keg spawns on the ground beside Kranal Fiss. Skip it if it is not there.
Use the keg to start its quest. Skip both steps if the keg was not on the ground.

821.name: Chen's Empty Keg
text: Bring 5 Savannah Lion Tusks, 5 Plainstrider Kidneys, and 1 Thunder Lizard Horn to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet.
notes: Plainstriders in the northwest.
Pink thunder lizards.

823.name: Report to Orgnil
text: Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

825.name: From The Wreckage
text: Gar'Thok of Razor Hill wants you to retrieve 3 Gnomish Tools from the wreckage off the coast.

826.name: Zalazane
text: Defeat Zalazane.
Kill 8 Voodoo Trolls and 8 Hexed Trolls.
Bring Zalazane's Head to Gadrin.

827.name: Skull Rock
text: Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock.
Bring them to Margoz at his camp.

828.name: Margoz
text: Speak with Margoz.

829.name: Neeru Fireblade
text: Bring an Example Collar to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

830.name: The Admiral's Orders
text: Take Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.

831.name: The Admiral's Orders
text: Deliver Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar.

832.name: Burning Shadows
text: Take this eye to Neeru Fireblade.

833.name: A Sacred Burial
text: Lorekeeper Raintotem wants you to kill 8 Bristleback Interlopers at Red Rocks.

834.name: Winds in the Desert
text: Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.

835.name: Securing the Lines
text: Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.

837.name: Encroachment
text: Kill 4 Razormane Quilboars, 4 Razormane Scouts, 4 Razormane Dustrunners and 4 Razormane Battleguards for Gar'Thok at Razor Hill.

840.name: Conscript of the Horde
text: Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the Barrens over a bridge.
Stop at the orc outpost across the bridge.
Give Kargal Battlescar at the Barrens outpost your recruitment letter.

842.name: Crossroads Conscription
text: Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost.
At the T intersection, turn left and follow the road south.
Find Sergra Darkthorn at the crossing of roads within the Crossroads.

843.name: Gann's Reclamation
text: Gann Stonespire wants you to kill 15 Bael'dun Excavators and 5 Bael'dun Foremen.
Bring Khazgorm's Journal to Gann Stonespire.

844.name: Plainstrider Menace
text: Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks and return them to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

845.name: The Zhevra
text: Slay Zhevra Runners to collect 4 Zhevra Hooves for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
notes: Zhevra Runners are the zebras south of the Crossroads.

846.name: Revenge of Gann
text: Gann Stonespire wants you to bring him 6 vials of Nitroglycerin, 6 bundles of Wood Pulp, and 6 samples of Sodium Nitrate.

848.name: Fungal Spores
text: Bring 4 Fungal Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads.
notes: Large blue mushrooms around the pools.
Laden Mushrooms lie around the Forgotten Pools. The Kolkar here are level 12 to 14; keep your distance. The follow-up rewards the Cauldron Stirrer, a strong staff at this level.
Helbrim plays out a scene first. Apothecary Zamah is timed: 45 minutes to reach Thunder Bluff, so do not stop on the way.

849.name: Revenge of Gann
text: Destroy the flying machine at Bael Modan and return to Gann Stonespire.

850.name: Kolkar Leaders
text: Bring Barak's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
notes: Regthar Deathgate is upstairs in the bunker west of the Crossroads.
Barak Kodobane walks around the Kolkar camp north of the pools.
Turn in Centaur Bracers too if you already have 15.

851.name: Verog the Dervish
text: Bring Verog's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
notes: Turn in Centaur Bracers too if you already have 15.
Kill Kolkar centaurs around the Stagnant Oasis until Verog the Dervish yells that he has been summoned, then kill him at his tent.

852.name: Hezrul Bloodmark
text: Bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
notes: Return to the Barrens. Hezrul Bloodmark walks the road south of the Forgotten Pools with two guards.

text: Bring the Rendered Spores to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, before the time limit is up.
notes: Apothecary Zamah is timed. Fly to Thunder Bluff straight away.
In the Pools of Vision, the cave under the Spirit Rise. The way in is at 29.89, 29.80.
Apothecary Zamah is timed once accepted. It is turned in at Thunder Bluff later in this route.
Helbrim plays out a scene first. Apothecary Zamah is timed: 45 minutes to reach Thunder Bluff, so do not stop on the way.
Take the Cauldron Stirrer if you use a staff, and equip it.

854.name: Journey to the Crossroads
text: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.

855.name: Centaur Bracers
text: Bring 15 Centaur Bracers to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
notes: Regthar Deathgate is upstairs in the bunker west of the Crossroads.

858.name: Ignition
text: Get the Ignition Key and bring it to Wizzlecrank.
notes: Wizzlecrank's Shredder starts an escort at the Venture Co. drill site. It has a long respawn; skip Ignition and The Escape if it is missing.
Supervisor Lugwizzle walks both levels of the platform. Skip if too hard.

860.name: Sergra Darkthorn
text: Speak with Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.

861.name: The Hunter's Way
text: Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

862.name: Dig Rat Stew
text: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.

863.name: The Escape

objectives.text: Escort Wizzlecrank out of the Venture Co. drill site

text: Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
notes: Follow and protect the shredder out of the drill site.

865.name: Raptor Horns
text: Gather 5 Intact Raptor Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, and bring them to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
notes: Purple raptors south of the oasis.
Innkeeper Wiley is here. Binding your hearthstone to Ratchet now saves a flight after the dungeon, whose first turn-ins are in Ratchet.
Keep 3 Sunscale Feathers from the same raptors for The Angry Scytheclaws.

866.name: Root Samples
text: Bring 8 Root Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.

867.name: Harpy Raiders
text: Collect 8 Witchwing talons.
Return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
notes: Darsok Swiftdagger is on top of the tower.
Harpies at the Dry Hills to the northwest.
Darsok is at the top of the tower.

868.name: Egg Hunt
text: Bring 12 Silithid Eggs and the Digging Claw to Korran at the Crossroads.

869.name: Raptor Thieves
text: Bring 12 Raptor Heads to Gazrog at the Crossroads.
notes: Sunscale raptors are dense north of the Sludge Fen. Finish Raptor Thieves here.

870.name: The Forgotten Pools

objectives.text: Explore the waters of the Forgotten Pools

text: Report back to Tonga Runetotem with your findings.
notes: Swim down beside the bubbling rock in the Forgotten Pools.
Swim next to the bubbling rock underwater.

871.name: Disrupt the Attacks
text: Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.

872.name: The Disruption Ends
text: Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout.
Then bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Thork at the Crossroads.
notes: Kreenig Snarlsnout walks around the north side of the mountain.

873.name: Isha Awak
text: Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.

874.name: Mahren Skyseer
text: Speak with Mahren Skyseer.

875.name: Harpy Lieutenants
text: Collect 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings from Witchwing Slayers and return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
notes: Witchwing Slayers in the far northwest. Avoid Sister Rathtalon, the elite green harpy, and watch for stealthed harpies.

876.name: Serena Bloodfeather
text: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
notes: Serena Bloodfeather is at the top of the Dry Hills. Stealthed harpies guard her.

877.name: The Stagnant Oasis
text: Return to Tonga at The Crossroads, after investigating the Stagnant Oasis.
notes: Underwater in the Stagnant Oasis, on the way back from Ratchet.
Underwater.

878.name: Tribes at War
text: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

text: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

880.name: Altered Beings
text: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
notes: Turtles in and around the Stagnant Oasis.

881.name: Echeyakee
text: Bring Echeyakee's Hide to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
notes: Use the Horn of Echeyakee at the bones around the mountain northeast of the Crossroads. A white lion spawns nearby.

882.name: Ishamuhale
text: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
notes: Fly or run back to Camp Taurajo.
Use the carcass at the bones; Ishamuhale is the raptor that appears.
Mangletooth trades Blood Shards for 30-minute buffs: Agamaggan's Strength, Agility, Wisdom, Rising Spirit, Razorhide, and a 5-minute run speed. Spend spare shards here while you quest in the Barrens.

883.name: Lakota'Mani
text: Bring the Hoof of Lakota'mani to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
notes: Use the hoof to start its quest.
Mangletooth trades Blood Shards for 30-minute buffs: Agamaggan's Strength, Agility, Wisdom, Rising Spirit, Razorhide, and a 5-minute run speed. Spend spare shards here while you quest in the Barrens.

884.name: Owatanka
text: Bring Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.

885.name: Washte Pawne
text: Bring Washte Pawne's Feather to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

886.name: The Barrens Oases
text: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
notes: Druids: fly to Thunder Bluff first. Hamuul Runetotem is on the Elder Rise.

887.name: Southsea Freebooters
text: Kill 12 Southsea Brigands and 6 Southsea Cannoneers for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
notes: Gazlowe is upstairs inside the building.

888.name: Stolen Booty

890.name: The Missing Shipment
text: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.

892.name: The Missing Shipment
text: Return Gazlowe's Ledger to Gazlowe in Ratchet.

893.name: Weapons of Choice
text: Bring a Razormane Backstabber, a Charred Razormane Wand and a Razormane War Shield to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

894.name: Samophlange
text: Access the control console at the Venture Company research site.
notes: The Samophlange chain is all at the Sludge Fen.

895.name: WANTED: Baron Longshore
text: Bring the head of Baron Longshore to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
notes: Baron Longshore wears a red trenchcoat and walks the coast south of Ratchet.

896.name: Miner's Fortune
text: Retrieve the Cats Eye Emerald from one of the Venture Co. Overseers or Enforcers for Wharfmaster Dizzywig at Ratchet.
notes: Boulder Lode Mine: follow the path up from 61.54, 6.68.

897.name: The Harvester
text: Bring the Harvester's Head to Jorn Skyseer.

898.name: Free From the Hold

objectives.text: Escort Gilthares Firebough back to Ratchet

text: Safely escort Gilthares Firebough back to Captain Brightsun in Ratchet.

899.name: Consumed by Hatred
text: Bring 60 Bristleback Quilboar Tusks to Mankrik at the Crossroads.
notes: Bristleback quilboar east of Taurajo. Keep any Blood Shards that drop.

900.name: Samophlange
text: Close off the Fuel Control Valve, the Regulator Valve and the Main Control Valve then use the control console again.
notes: The Samophlange chain is all at the Sludge Fen.
Two enemies may attack at each valve.

901.name: Samophlange
text: Get the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles to use on the control console.
notes: Tinkerer Sniggles is inside the building.

902.name: Samophlange
text: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.

903.name: Prowlers of the Barrens
text: Collect 7 Prowler Claws from Savannah Prowlers for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
notes: Savannah Prowlers west of the bunker.

905.name: The Angry Scytheclaws
text: Kill Sunscale raptors and collect their feathers. Use the feathers on the 3 Scytheclaw nests. Return to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

906.name: Betrayal from Within
text: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.

907.name: Enraged Thunder Lizards
text: Bring 3 Thunder Lizard Blood to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
notes: Mangletooth trades Blood Shards for 30-minute buffs: Agamaggan's Strength, Agility, Wisdom, Rising Spirit, Razorhide, and a 5-minute run speed. Spend spare shards here while you quest in the Barrens.

913.name: Cry of the Thunderhawk
text: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
notes: Flying snakes around Taurajo.

914.name: Leaders of the Fang
text: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
notes: The first boss. She stands in the Screaming Gully, in one of several spots.
Take the water path west out of the Screaming Gully into the Pit of Fangs and climb around it. He is at the top.
Back through the Screaming Gully, follow the water east through the Crag of the Everliving into the Winding Chasm. Go right through the small pool; he is at its north end.

From Pythas head southeast, turn left at the candles, and pass the pool on your left to the fence where Skum waits. Go right of the fence, southwest to the Crag of the Everliving, jump the gap by the small waterfall and follow the upper path to him.

924.name: The Demon Seed
text: Grab a Flawed Power Stone. Bring it to the Altar of Fire before the stone expires, then return to Ak'Zeloth.
notes: Ak'Zeloth is on the road from Durotar.
Run up Dreadmist Peak from 50.93, 22.55. The altar is inside the small cave.

959.name: Trouble at the Docks
text: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz in Ratchet wants you to retrieve the bottle of 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish who is hiding in the Wailing Caverns.
notes: Mad Magglish is stealthed and slow to respawn. Skip this if he is not up; you can look again on the way out.

962.name: Serpentbloom
text: Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff wants you to collect 10 Serpentbloom.
notes: In the Pools of Vision, the cave under the Spirit Rise. The way in is at 29.89, 29.80.
Small green, purple and pink plants along the walls. There are not enough for a whole group in one run; agree who picks.
Back down in the Pools of Vision.

1013.name: The Book of Ur
text: Bring the Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.
notes: In the Apothecarium. The zeppelin from Orgrimmar lands in Tirisfal, a short walk from the Undercity.

Past Baron Silverlaine and Commander Springvale, down and along the outside path, then Odo the Blindwatcher. Kill Fenrus the Devourer; the book is a blue book on the shelf on the left side of his room.
Fly to the Undercity from Karos Razok (45.62, 42.58) and go down to the Apothecarium.

1014.name: Arugal Must Die
text: Kill Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
notes: At the Sepulcher. Fly from Michael Garrett (Undercity 63.25, 48.56) if you know the flight path; otherwise leave the Undercity and walk south into Silverpine.
The last boss, at the top of the keep.
North to the Sepulcher.

text: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of Stonetalon Sap, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a Fey Dragon Scale.
notes: Follow the path up through the mountains from 82.07, 98.57. Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is inside the small cave at Malaka'jin.

1060.name: Letter to Jin'Zil
text: Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
notes: Follow the path up through the mountains from 82.07, 98.57. Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is inside the small cave at Malaka'jin.

1061.name: The Spirits of Stonetalon
text: Speak with Seereth Stonebreak in the Stonetalon Mountains.
notes: Zor Lonetree is inside the building in the Valley of Wisdom.
Seereth Stonebreak and Makaba Flathoof camp at the western edge of the Barrens, on the road to Stonetalon.

1062.name: Goblin Invaders
text: Kill 15 Venture Co. Loggers, then return to Seereth Stonebreak on the border of Stonetalon and the Barrens.
notes: Seereth Stonebreak and Makaba Flathoof camp at the western edge of the Barrens, on the road to Stonetalon.

1063.name: The Elder Crone
text: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
notes: Watch the dialogue, then talk to Seereth Stonebreak again.

1064.name: Forsaken Aid
text: Speak with Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.

1065.name: Journey to Tarren Mill
text: Bring Zamah's Note to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

1066.name: Blood of Innocents
text: Bring 5 Vials of Innocent Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

1067.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
text: Bring Lydon's Toxin to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff.

1068.name: Shredding Machines
text: Kill the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, then return to Seereth Stonebreak at the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens.

1069.name: Deepmoss Spider Eggs
text: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
notes: Large white eggs among the spiders. Hatchlings can summon a level 22 spider; run if needed.

1086.name: The Flying Machine Airport
text: Bring the Toxic Fogger to the Venture Co. sky port, then return to Apothecary Zamah.

1087.name: Cenarius' Legacy
text: Kill 4 Sons of Cenarius, 4 Daughters of Cenarius and 4 Cenarion Botanists for Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.

1088.name: Ordanus
text: Bring Ordanus' head to Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.

1089.name: The Den
text: Travel to the Den on Stonetalon Peak. Using the Gatekeeper's Key, obtain the druids' hidden items. Use these items to open the Talon Den Hoard.

1090.name: Gerenzo's Orders
text: Get the mysterious ore from Piznik after he finishes mining it.

1092.name: Gerenzo's Orders
text: Deliver the Unidentified Ore to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.

1093.name: Super Reaper 6000
text: Get the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints for Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
notes: Leave Sishir Canyon to the northeast from 57.27, 76.35. Ziz Fizziks is inside the building at Windshear Crag.

1094.name: Further Instructions
text: Deliver the Sealed Envelope to Sputtervalve in the Barrens.

1095.name: Further Instructions
text: Bring the new orders to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.

1096.name: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle
text: Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.

1098.name: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
text: Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
notes: Down in the crypt. The way in is at 43.09, 41.38.
Once the door opens, drop down to the right of the stairs into the courtyard. Deathstalker Vincent is there.

1130.name: Melor Sends Word
text: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

1131.name: Steelsnap
text: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

1195.name: The Sacred Flame
text: Return a Filled Etched Phial to Zangen Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

text: Deliver the Filled Etched Phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.

1197.name: The Sacred Flame
text: Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.

1198.name: In Search of Thaelrid
text: Seek out Argent Guard Thaelrid in Blackfathom Deeps.

1221.name: Blueleaf Tubers
text: Grab a Crate with Holes.
Grab a Snufflenose Command Stick.
Grab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual.
In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.
Bring 6 Blueleaf Tubers, the Snufflenose Command Stick and the Crate with Holes to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.

1358.name: Sample for Helbrim
text: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.

1359.name: Zinge's Delivery
text: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

1470.name: Piercing the Veil
text: Bring Venya Marthand 3 Rattlecage Skulls.

text: Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

1472.name: Devourer of Souls
text: Speak with Godrick Farsan in the Temple of the Damned.

1473.name: Creature of the Void
text: Recover Egalin's Grimoire and bring it to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.

text: Using the Pure Hearts, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Pure Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

1476.name: Hearts of the Pure
text: Bring the hearts of Dalin Forgewright and Comar Villard to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.

text: Speak with Carendin Halgar in the Undercity.

text: Speak with Ziz Fizziks in Windshear Crag.
notes: Leave Sishir Canyon to the northeast from 57.27, 76.35. Ziz Fizziks is inside the building at Windshear Crag.

1485.name: Vile Familiars
text: Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan.

1486.name: Deviate Hides
text: Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns wants 20 Deviate Hides.

1487.name: Deviate Eradication
text: Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
notes: In the Screaming Gully.
In the Pit of Fangs.
In the Crag of the Everliving.
In the Winding Chasm.

1489.name: Hamuul Runetotem
text: Speak with Hamuul Runetotem.

1490.name: Nara Wildmane

Ectoplasms throughout the dungeon drop it.

1492.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
text: Bring the Secure Crate to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

1498.name: Path of Defense
text: Bring 5 Singed Scales to Uzzek at Far Watch Post in the Barrens.

1499.name: Vile Familiars
text: Speak with Zureetha Fargaze.

text: Retrieve the Tablet of Verga for Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

1502.name: Thun'grim Firegaze

1503.name: Forged Steel
text: Bring the Forged Steel Bars to Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
notes: Thun'grim Firegaze is on top of the mountain east of the Crossroads. Run up from 54.50, 27.94.

1504.name: The Binding
text: Using the Glyphs of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Glyphs of Summoning to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

1505.name: Veteran Uzzek
text: Speak with Uzzek at Far Watch Post.

1506.name: Gan'rul's Summons
text: Speak with Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

1507.name: Devourer of Souls
text: Speak with Cazul in the Cleft of Shadow.

text: Speak with Zankaja in Orgrimmar.

text: Speak with Gazrog at the Crossroads.

1512.name: Love's Gift
text: Bring the Dirt-caked Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

1513.name: The Binding
text: Using Dogran's Pendant, summon and subdue a succubus, then return Dogran's Pendant to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.

1515.name: Dogran's Captivity
text: Bring Ken'zigla's Draught to Dogran in the Barrens.

text: Bring 2 Felstalker Hooves to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.

1518.name: Call of Earth
text: Bring the Rough Quartz to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.

1520.name: Call of Earth
text: Find Kodo Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.

1521.name: Call of Earth
text: Bring the Rough Quartz to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.

text: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.

text: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Telf Joolam in Durotar.

1525.name: Call of Fire
text: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Telf Joolam in Durotar.

1526.name: Call of Fire
text: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.

1527.name: Call of Fire
text: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.

text: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

1529.name: Call of Water
text: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

1530.name: Call of Water
text: Find Brine in Southern Barrens.

1534.name: Call of Water
text: Fill the Empty Blue Waterskin at the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale and return to Brine in the Barrens.

1535.name: Call of Water
text: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the watering hole below Brine's hut and return it to her in the Barrens.

1536.name: Call of Water
text: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at the well in Tarren Mill and return to Brine in the Barrens.

1656.name: A Task Unfinished
text: Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
notes: Antur Fallow waits on the road west out of the camp. Take his quest with you: it turns in at Bloodhoof Village.

1740.name: The Orb of Soran'ruk
text: Find 3 Soran'ruk Fragments and 1 Large Soran'ruk Fragment and return them to Doan Karhan in the Barrens.
notes: Warlocks only, and far from Silverpine: press > to pass it over. Its three small fragments drop from Twilight Acolytes in Blackfathom Deeps; only the large one is in Shadowfang Keep.
Only the Shadowfang Darksouls drop it.
Once you also have the three fragments from Blackfathom Deeps.

1818.name: Speak with Dillinger
text: Speak with Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

1819.name: Ulag the Cleaver
text: Kill Ulag the Cleaver, then speak with Deathguard Dillinger.

1820.name: Speak with Coleman
text: Speak with Coleman Farthing.

1821.name: Agamand Heirlooms
text: Bring Coleman Farthing the Agamand Family Axe, the Agamand Family Sword, the Agamand Family Mace and the Agamand Family dagger.

1823.name: Speak with Ruga
text: Speak with Ruga Ragetotem.

text: Bring 5 twitching antennae to Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo

1825.name: Speak with Thun'grim
text: Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.

1838.name: Brutal Armor
text: Bring to Thun'grim Firegaze 15 Smoky Iron Ingots, 10 Powdered Azurite, 10 Iron Bars and a Vial of Phlogiston.

1839.name: Ula'elek and the Brutal Gauntlets
text: Speak with Ula'elek in Durotar.

text: Bring 7 Uncloven Satyr Hooves to Ula'elek at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.

1844.name: Chimaeric Horn

1846.name: Dragonmaw Shinbones
text: Bring 8 Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones to Velora Nitely in the Undercity.

text: Steal Tazan's key, then use it to open his Satchel and deliver its contents to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

1859.name: Therzok

text: Speak with Anastasia Hartwell.

1886.name: The Deathstalkers

Deliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, Barrens.
notes: Run up Dreadmist Peak from 50.93, 22.55 and use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler standing in the bubbling water at the top.

text: Bring 5 Earthroot and 5 Kodo Horns to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads so he may make a curative salve.
notes: Lost Barrens Kodos wander between the oasis and the road.
Earthroot is an herb: pick it if you are an herbalist, or buy it at the Auction House.

6129.name: Curing the Sick
text: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles that are located throughout the northern part of the Barrens; doing so should cure them. Sickly Gazelles have been reported north of the east-west road that runs through the Crossroads.
notes: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles, the green gazelles all over the northern Barrens.

6130.name: Power over Poison
text: Return to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff.

6381.name: New Life

6385.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master

6394.name: Thazz'ril's Pick
text: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.

6395.name: Marla's Last Wish
text: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

6401.name: Kaya's Alive
text: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

6421.name: Boulderslide Ravine
text: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

6442.name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
text: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

6461.name: Blood Feeders

notes: Xen'Zilla is inside the building at Camp Aparaje.
Green spiders.

6462.name: Troll Charm

6482.name: Freedom to Ruul
